title.narrative: Strengthening multi-actor partnerships in Cambodia to promote sustainable natural rubber value chains

description.narrative: Direct Participants/Beneficiaries:(1) 600 smallholders in the rubber industry.(2) 26 MAP member organisations.Indirect Participants/Beneficiaries:(1) 2,394 smallholders (non-beneficiaries of training).(2) 17 producer groups.(3) 1 cooperative in Mondulkiri and 10 cooperatives in Tbong Khmum. (11 cooperatives).(4) 2,694 individual smallholders and wage labourers.(5) 25 public sector representatives.

Overall objective - An independent and inclusive multi-actor partnership platform in Cambodia enables target groups to engage in sustainable natural rubber management, innovation and progressive strategies that lead to improved food and income security, agricultural productivity and resilience to climate change.Project Goal - Selected stakeholders are actively participating in the newly established multi-actor platform, and smallholder farmers and wage labourers in the rural provinces of Mondulkiri and Tbong Khmum are using their new knowledge to apply good agricultural practices for sustainable land management.

This project is a multi-country (Cambodia, Myanmar, Thailand)project, which builds on the processes, structures and momentum established in the first phase Multi-Actor Partnership Platform for Sustainable Natural Rubber. This project is expected to:(1) Scale up and intensify training on Good Agricultural Practices for 600 vulnerable smallholder farmers in two provinces. to increase their food and income security, productivity and resilience to climate change;(2) Enhance and sustain the MAP Platform and roadmap with 26 members;(3) Initiate further stakeholder engagement, policy dialogue and process facilitation through provincial and national forums.
